result.description: Vireli's Aurora Loom HDR Monitor 27QX is a fictional 27-inch desktop display designed for color-sensitive creative work and immersive viewing. It features a QHD 2560x1440 panel, 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response time, wide-gamut color coverage, and USB-C video input with 90W power delivery. The stand supports height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustments, while the matte anti-glare coating helps reduce reflections in bright workspaces.
